name: Thijs Reuten - § 14 - Am 18
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 14. Notes the deep instability in the Middle East and the West, North and Central Africa regions, and its linkage to the Jihadist terrorist threat; stresses that this instability poses a serious threat to the security of Europeans, who are facing increased migratory pressure that facilitates the entry of terrorists into European territory;
